name: gear-knit-scarf-wisp
prompt: The reference image shows a small floating flame-spirit creature with a narrow tapered body and no neck. Do NOT draw the creature. Draw ONLY a cozy knit scarf, alone on the background, shaped exactly as if it were wrapped snugly around THIS creature's narrow lower body: the band curves in a gentle downward bow matching the flame body's taper, narrow overall, with one short tail hanging down on the right ending in yarn fringe tassels. Sticker-flat cel style, every region ONE perfectly even solid color like a vector illustration — no shading variation, no wash, no mottling — one thick confident uniform rounded outline in a darker wine shade of the scarf's own color, never black. The ENTIRE scarf filled with deep muted berry red (#a34b54) — a dark, rich, saturated wine red, NOT pink, NOT pastel — with soft warm cream (#f2e9d3) for a few flat stitch dashes and the fringe. Scarf centered and large in frame, 10% margin, on a plain solid magenta (#ff00ff) background, no shadow. Negative constraints: no pink, no pastel colors, no gray, no gradients, no texture, no stipple, no halftone, no watercolor, no 3d render, no clay, no cast shadow, no drop shadow, no background scenery, no creature, no body, no face, no eyes, no flame, no outline sketchiness, no black outline, no text, no watermark, no sticker border, no die-cut white edge.
